scope: HTTP startup vertical slice only. Pipe adapter is NOT built in G20.

reasoning.startup_transport: Startup contact is via HTTP (WININET/WINHTTP) to the private server. The NESYS named pipe \\.pipe\nesys_games is scoped to NESYS card operations (read/insert/reissue/status), which occur outside the HTTP startup vertical slice.
reasoning.pipe_role_unresolved: G19 evidence: the game imports BOTH ConnectNamedPipe and WaitNamedPipeA, so server-vs-client role is unresolved. This does not affect the HTTP startup contract.
reasoning.no_dependency: No HTTP startup route (boot/version/resource/matching_server/game_data_load) depends on the named pipe. Pipe is only relevant to the deferred player/card-session workstream.

deferred.card_session_pipe: Player/card session requires the pipe; role resolution + minimal adapter deferred to a later phase (do not revive original NesysService recovery).

allowed_classifications_considered.PIPE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_HTTP_STARTUP: rejected - no evidence startup HTTP depends on the pipe
allowed_classifications_considered.PIPE_REQUIRED_ONLY_FOR_PLAYER_SESSION: matches card-session workstream but is deferred, not part of this slice
allowed_classifications_considered.PIPE_REQUIREMENT_UNRESOLVED: role unresolved, but startup does not depend on it
